# Gymbo

> Gymbo is an iOS business app for independent personal trainers in India. It turns the day-to-day of running a training practice — logging sessions, tracking payments and balances, scheduling, and looking professional — into a few taps. One flat subscription, unlimited clients, 14-day free trial.

Gymbo is built for the independent personal trainer — not a gym chain, and not a dietitian. A trainer's day is sessions, schedules, and payments, so Gymbo is built around that: a one-tap punch to log a class, a client card that does the balance math automatically, and colour-coded balances that flag who owes — with a daily summary emailed to you. A workout builder, an AI assistant, and a shareable QR profile card are built in. Clients don't download anything — Gymbo is for the trainer.

## Key features

- One-tap session logging (punch a class) with automatic balance math
- Payment and balance tracking — cash or UPI, GST invoices, colour-coded reminders
- Scheduling and your full client roster in one place
- Workout builder with a template library + voice/paste import (build and assign workouts)
- AI assistant (chat) for your training-business questions
- A shareable QR profile card and branded PDF statements
- Passwordless sign-in (Apple + Face ID); works offline and syncs when back online

## Pricing

- Monthly: ₹399/month (billed monthly)
- Annual: ₹2,999 per year (₹250/month effective, save 37%)
- Unlimited clients on every plan; 14-day free trial, no card required
